description: A motorised volume fader: it scales an audio signal, sends its own position out as a control voltage, and drives itself from a control voltage when one is patched

params.text: Sets the level, from silence to 6dB above unity, marked in decibels down the scale beside it; the gain applied to the audio is the square of the position

inputs.text: Drives the fader: 10V holds it where it stood when the cable went in, and the position scales in proportion, so 5V halves it and 0V silences it. Dragging takes control back while the mouse is down.

outputs.text: The fader position as a voltage, 0V at silence and 10V at the top

notes: a name can be written on the fader from the menu, and it is drawn down the panel beside it.
menu: the text field at the top — holds the name written beside the fader
Fader Cap Color: white, grey, black, red, blue, green, brown, orange, pink, purple — chooses the colour of the fader cap
Audio Polyphony Mode: Poly In - Poly Out, Poly In - Mono Out — chooses whether a polyphonic input keeps its channels or is summed to one
CV-Scale Mode: VCV Standard, MindMeld MixMaster — chooses the law the CV output follows, either ten times the fader position or a curve matching a MixMaster fader

inputs.1:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the fader stays where it is put.
